title: Warriors of Wandering Lights
description: WOWL - Bring your characters to life in a roleplay experience dedicated to Warrior cat fans.
body:
Warriors of Wandering Lights is a Warrior cats roleplay server with 4 fan-made Clans, loners, loner groups, and extra territories. StarClan has spoken to these cats, and together they must seek peace among each other. WOWL has plenty to offer, such as...
- **Character creation through a command**, ability to change aspects whenever!
- Create up to **15 characters**
- **Warriors themed economy**; buy items with berries, use blocks to decorate your loner den! Sell items to gain more berries
- **Free ranks** given through **playtime**
- **High-ranks** and mediators through applications
- **Custom items** (such as feathers, berries, beetles) and **custom prey textures** (birds, mice, squirrels)
- **Gatherings** on the first Saturday of every month at 6pm CST
- **Custom prey models!**
- **Events** such as Easter egg hunts and art contests for **free ranks**!

### To learn more about our server, join us now!
